profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software developer with a broad base of experience including desktop and mobile applications, operating systems, interactive web-apps, and scripting.  Most interested in iOS and Mac OS X app development with over a decade of experience with Objective-C and Cocoa.

Specialties: Objective-C, C; iOS and Mac app development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Development and maintenance of software tools, test infrastructure and tests in support of new OS X releases. In this role my focus is on writing Objective-C apps for Mac and iOS devices, but I also work extensively in other areas including Ruby on Rails web apps and Python scripting.

Also responsible for coordinating teams of integration engineers to test and report on specific, often highly-visible, aspects of a release. In this capacity I work closely with engineers from other divisions of the company to help ensure an excellent experience and high-quality release.

positions.title: Independent Software Developer
positions.description: Hobby independent software development.  Released two products for Mac OS X: DailyComic, a comic strip browser application written in Objective-C, and Fountain Music, an OpenGL-based visualizer for Apple iTunes which animates particles in time to music.  Both have been downloaded by thousands of users and  have received overall excellent reviews.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Holding office hours, updating lecture slides, grading student projects, assisting professor during lecture.

Courses:
CSCI1230 - Introduction to Computer Graphics, prof. Andy van Dam (Fall 2008)
CSCI0160 - Intro to Data Structures and Algorithms, prof. John F. Hughes (Spring 2009)

positions.title: Head Teaching Assistant (HTA)
positions.description:
Working with professor and students to coordinate and organize all aspects of 60+ student course. Managing a team of 11 undergraduate teaching assistants (UTAs) with a co-head TA.  Performing standard teaching assistant duties (grading, revising project, holding office hours). 

Courses:
CS31 - Introduction to Computer Systems (Fall 2007)
CS16 - Introduction to Data Structures and Algorithms (Spring 2008)

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Graded homeworks, projects and tests, held weekly hours to help students with questions. Co-designed and updated course website.  Gave lecture on class project. Maintained grades database.

Courses:
CS31 - Intro to Computer Systems (Fall 2006)
CS16 - Intro to Data Structures and Algorithms (Spring 2007)

positions.title: Intern Web Developer
positions.description: Developed intranet website for internal documents using Adobe ColdFusion designed database schema for documents and XML schema for conﬁguration ﬁles, worked with staff to adapt site and assist in the transition to Sotheby’s afﬁliation

positions.title: Intern Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed, wrote telecommunications software component in C++ to automatically verify user input against an XML description.
